headline: SAUCE WALKA'S STREAMING RUN BY THE NUMBERS
body: Akademiks says Sauce Walka made money from streaming this week. Third-party tracker Streams Charts reports that his Kick channel logged more than 364 hours of airtime during its latest 30-day window and averaged 189 viewers, while Apple Music lists 'Thuggin'' as his latest music release dated August 28. No platform or contract source independently published an exact earnings figure, so RapWire is reporting the activity and leaving the dollar amount unconfirmed.
